correctness.rationale: For any balanced spin assignment, the hub-spoke K term equals -K and the uniform field term vanishes, including after every allowed exchange. The exchange energy differences give exactly the forbidden cyclic rim patterns '---' for a negative rim spin swapping with positive hub and '++--'/'--++' for rim swaps. The remaining negative runs are only singles and doubles; if t doubles, q=(n+1)/2 negative spins imply u=q-2t singles and positive-run extra length t-1. Long positive runs occur only between two singleton-negative runs. Counting circular S/D blocks with s blocks yields the stated A_(q,t) via cyclic compositions and stars-bars; the energy level is E0+4J(t-1), t>=1. For t>=2 feasibility u>=2 gives first n=11, and explicit t=2 witnesses exist from then onward. The constructed DSS family gives central-binomial multiplicity and liminf log(B_n)/n>=log2/4. Independent direct adjacency-exchange exhaustive calculations for odd n=3..13 agreed with the exact sum; the finite work corroborates the all-n run bijection. No claim that weak minima are absorbing under zero-energy moves.
residual_risks: The claimed positive exponential lower bound is not a sharp entropy asymptotic, and weak minima allow neutral moves.
